scholarships.title: McCall MacBain Scholarships at McGill University
scholarships.degree: Master's, Second-Entry Professional Undergraduate (JD/BCL, MD, DMD)
scholarships.official_source: McCall MacBain Scholarships at McGill (McGill University / McCall MacBain Foundation)

existing.description: The McCall MacBain Scholarships at McGill University is a full graduate scholarship for candidates entering a full-time master's or second-entry professional undergraduate program at McGill. For the 2027 cohort the programme awards up to 30 full scholarships and up to 100 finalist and regional awards. The scholarship covers tuition and fees for the full normal duration of the programme, a living stipend of $2,300 per month during academic terms, and a one-time relocation grant, with up to $5,000 available for summer initiatives. Applicants must satisfy at least one of three recency or age criteria and meet McGill's minimum admission requirements. Applications for Summer/Fall 2027 closed on August 19 or September 23, 2026 depending on applicant group, and the programme runs annually.
eligibility: Current student on track to earn your first bachelor's degree by August 2027
Earned your first bachelor's degree in the last five years (January 2021 or later)
Earned your first bachelor's degree more than five years ago and were 30 years or younger on January 1, 2026
Meet the minimum degree and language requirements for McGill master's program admission
Applying for Summer/Fall 2027 admission to a full-time master's or second-entry professional undergraduate program at McGill University consisting of 45 credits or more
Program must take place primarily on McGill's downtown or Macdonald campuses
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must meet at least one of three criteria: be a current student on track to earn a first bachelor's degree by August 2027; have earned a first bachelor's degree in the last five years (January 2021 or later); or have earned a first bachelor's degree more than five years ago and have been 30 years or younger on January 1, 2026. Applicants must also meet McGill's minimum degree and language requirements for master's admission.

existing.selection_notes: Candidates are assessed on exceptional character, community engagement, leadership potential, entrepreneurial spirit, and academic strength and intellectual curiosity. More than 250 semi-finalists are invited to regional interviews, and approximately 85 finalists are invited to final interviews in Montreal.
existing.best_fit: Students and recent graduates with strong leadership and community records who intend to enter a full-time master's or second-entry professional program (JD, MD or DMD) at McGill University.
existing.duration: Yes, but you must apply for a full-time eligible graduate program at McGill. Award recipients must pursue their studies full-time.
existing.application_period: Applications open online in June and close in August or September each year for Summer/Fall admission the following year; the 2027 cohort closed on August 19 and September 23, 2026.
existing.deadline_display: The 2027 cycle has closed: September 23, 2026 at 4:00 PM Eastern Time for students and graduates of universities in Canada and the United States and Canadians abroad, and August 19, 2026 at 4:00 PM Eastern Time for applicants from all other countries. The application is available online from June to August/September each year for Summer/Fall entry the following year.
existing.program_type: Full graduate scholarship for a full-time master's or second-entry professional undergraduate program at McGill University, combined with an interdisciplinary leadership curriculum.
